_comment: license-checker config for Node projects. Run: npx license-checker --json --production --excludePrivatePackages | node scripts/validate-licenses.mjs

exceptions._comment: Per-package overrides — bypass license-bucket checks for specific deps. Format: pkg-name → reason.
exceptions.buffers: Custom URL license — actual is permissive (see http://github.com/substack/node-bufferlist). Used by node-tar, dev-only
exceptions.readline: BSD* (variant) — permissive BSD form; pkg metadata uses non-canonical SPDX
